title: assure.NotPassedAt
description: Reads the ledger from the reader and lists, in ID order, every automated test record whose result at the commit is not passed in a release-grade proof run, with its result or none, and every test record in another state; computed on each call. A change-grade attestation gives no result. The walk that fills Last passed at stops once every automated test record has passed somewhere, so a test record in another state can show no last pass although an older proof run within the depth passed it.

title: appbuild.Verify
description: Verify checks the executable against the trusted record.

title: appbuild.VerifySource
description: VerifySource checks a source snapshot against the record's source inventory.

title: appbuild.VerifyImage
description: VerifyImage refuses a missing record digest or signature input by name first, checks the image against its record and its trusted build record through verifyImageBuild, checks both SBOM attestations against a private copy of the manifest through checkImageSignature, and gives the verification through ImageVerifyReader.

title: appbuild.RetrieveImage
description: RetrieveImage refuses a missing signature input, missing credentials and every other input before it connects, reads the image from its explicit place in the registry into a staging folder through registryImage, checks it against its record, its trusted build record and its signature, and only then moves it to the result folder and writes registry.json with the signature; it removes the staging folder when a check fails.

title: declaration.Validate
description: Validate runs the checks that read only the declaration, with the fields that the strict reading stage found undeclared, and returns every fault in five groups (undeclared fields, service, entities, collections, slot bindings) so that the compile check reports them in a fixed order. Each fault names its rule and path. It writes no file.

title: fleet.FindByDigest
description: FindByDigest reads the sweep through the SweepReader alone and gives each checkout once: every recorded service that pins the digest, with the component, version and digest it holds, every other recorded service, and every checkout without a readable record as unknown with its path and reason.

title: lifecycle.PinStanding
description: PinStanding gives each pin of the service with its standing, read through the StandingReader: superseded with its successor and fail date (IsSuperseded), withdrawn with its reason and fail date (IsWithdrawn), past its fail date on the day (IsPastFailDate), or unchecked with the cause when the lifecycle records cannot be read, so no pin is reported as current.

title: main.currentIdentity
description: currentIdentity gives the version and the build identity that buildidentity.Current reads from the Go build metadata. Apply, the application build and the generated command line read the same shared buildidentity.Current.

title: fleet.VEX
description: VEX reads the sweep through the SweepReader and the lifecycles that lifecycle.Store read from the lifecycle folder of the registry checkout, and gives one OpenVEX statement for each advisory and each checkout: affected when the service pins the digest, fixed when it pins the successor, not_affected with its justification otherwise, and under_investigation for a checkout without a readable record or an advisory about the runtime library, which the record does not name. It writes nothing.

title: delivery.UnmetRequirements
description: Gives each row of the environment fit that the reader EnvironmentReader holds whose status is not met, in the order of the fit. It reads nothing else.

title: fill.ListCatalog
description: ListCatalog builds the catalog of one slot and reads it back through fill.CatalogReader. fill.ResolveSlot first finds the slot in the active component set: it refuses an unknown slot with the slots the set declares, an ambiguous name with the components that declare it, and a component that the set does not hold. runRegistryFills (stego registry fills) prints the entries.

title: fill.ListQualification
description: ListQualification builds the qualification of each bound fill and reads it back through fill.QualificationReader; a fill whose evidence and sign-off are current but that breaks a fill rule now shows as untested, with each fault as a reason (decision on ST-EXT-Q06, 2026-11-11). The bound fills are the fills of the slot bindings and the fill of each command, query and worker, whose binding names no collection and whose contract digest is fill.CapabilityContractDigest: the digest of the declarations of its generated contract package that the fill compiles against, which compiler.FillCheck.CapabilityContract gives from the plan (decision on ST-EXT-Q30). A fill whose files or contract cannot be read is untested, with the reason. fill.QualificationFaults gives the compiler (compiler.FillQualifier) a fault for each bound fill that does not fit its binding or is not qualified, which names what to run, and for each fill of a command, a query, a worker or a slot binding that breaks the fill rules with its own slot contract, so validate, plan and apply stop on it and write nothing. A fill of a command, query or worker that holds no Go code yet cannot be built and does not stop generation.

title: compiler.DetectDrift
description: DetectDrift refuses while a journal is pending, reads the record, and compares every generated file and recorded input with the disk. It also reads go.mod against the archetype the record holds: a runtime requirement at another version than the pin, a missing pin that generated code imports, a version that is not tagged, another STEGO module or a replace of one is drift on go.mod.

title: compiler.LoadPlan
description: LoadPlan reads .stego/plan.yaml through the strict decoder and writes nothing. stego plan --show prints it with FormatSavedPlan, and SavedPlan.StillApplies tells whether a plan made now from the inputs on disk gives the same saved plan.

title: compiler.Validate
description: Validate loads the declaration and the registry once, runs the registry, generator and fill checks, and puts the groups of faults from declaration.Validate between them in a fixed order. Plan and apply run the same check before they generate. The facts of the composition checks hold the kind of each method of the proto files of grpc-application, which grpc_methods.go reads with grpcapplication.Methods (ST-DECL-INV73).

title: compiler.CheckBase
description: CheckBase reads the record and the declaration that stego compat read at the base ref. With no record it accepts any stored shape; it refuses a base declaration whose digest is not the record's declaration digest; otherwise it parses the base declaration and runs validateBaseSchema against the head. It gives the base ref, its commit and each fault with the schema change and phase to declare, and writes nothing.

title: compiler.ExportArchitecture
description: ExportArchitecture refuses a format that is not structurizr or mermaid, reads the model and its record through compiler.ReadArchitecture, and refuses a view that the format does not have. It computes on each call, from the model alone, one Structurizr DSL workspace (the service as a software system, each container with its components and fills, a relationship for each binding, need, slot fill and call of a request flow, and the container, component and dynamic views), or Mermaid text (the erDiagram of the entities and a sequenceDiagram of each request flow, as one Markdown block each when no view is given). A header comment names the model with its hash, the record, and the declaration, registry content and input digests that the record holds, each only when it is a SHA-256 digest. Each text of the model has its control and bidirectional characters escaped and its quotes replaced, so it cannot end a string of the diagram; in the DSL each $ is [U+0024], so no ${NAME} substitution reads the renderer's environment, and in Mermaid each % is an entity code, so no %%{init}%% directive gets in. It writes nothing.

title: compiler.ListComplianceFacts
description: ListComplianceFacts refuses a topic that compiler.ComplianceTopics does not hold, reads the model through compiler.ReadArchitecture, and projects the facts of the topic from the model alone: each fact with its value, state and source, the rule of each default, the reason of each public access check as a quotation of the declaration, and the grant paths of the permission that each check names, or that its grants are not known. The access list says that it covers only the declared operations and actions. It gives them as text grouped by element, or as one JSON object with keys in a fixed order. Each value of the model is escaped for the terminal, and a value or name that holds a word of a claim is quoted, so STEGO's own words never say that the service complies. It writes nothing.

title: main.runRegistryInspect
description: runRegistryInspect answers for the component a person names, as text; with --archetype it reports every declarable input of the archetype's active component set, which compiler.ActiveComponents resolves as checking does, through registry.InputsReader, as a table or with --json as one JSON document. It refuses an archetype the registry does not hold, naming the archetypes it holds, and prints no row.

title: main.runRegistrySearch
description: runRegistrySearch keeps the components that match the -provides, -requires and -slot filters, in name order, as a table with the version, the stage and the trust of the source that supplies each.

title: registry.ListConsumers
description: ListConsumers gives every recorded service that uses one component, with the version its generation record names, from the read model the run built.

title: registry.MissedSunsets
description: MissedSunsets gives every recorded service that uses a component of the active registry past its sunset on the day the caller gives (ST-SUP-SP04), with the component, its stage and its sunset date. Every such service is reported: an acceptance in a declaration cannot reach past the sunset.
